(2) Processing pipeline

How far each instrument's record went through processing: read from the originator's or instrument's file → standardized (units, names) → trimmed to the deployment → checked → combined into the mooring time series → interpolated onto a common pressure grid. Green: done; grey: not reached. HAB: height above bottom.

Pressure range for the gridded product. The instruments' measured pressures span 360–700 dbar (rounded outward to 20 dbar). To grid this mooring over that range, set pmin and pmax in the grid: block of the mooring description, or pass them on the command line, from the folder holding the mooring description (the stage files are kept, so no raw files are needed): 

oceanarray run dune2_1_2026.mooring.yaml --from 3 --pmin 360 --pmax 700

(3) Deployment timing

Stage 1 and Sugg. (raw) columns are in the raw instrument clock (uncorrected). Sugg. UTC columns apply the constant clock offset (and drift, for the end) and are safe to paste into the YAML deployment_time / recovery_time fields. Suggested UTC cells are highlighted amber when the pressure-derived suggested time differs from the YAML time by more than 2 Δt (indicating a sinking/rising transient was detected). The Stage 1 last cell is highlighted orange when the raw record ended more than 2 Δt before the YAML recovery time (instrument may have stopped early). Serial numbers link to the per-instrument report; the 6 h link jumps directly to the start/end window plots.

Spot-check recommended: open the 6 h start/end window plots for each instrument (click 6 h) and visually confirm that the orange suggested line (or green YAML line if they match) sits at a plausible transition in the pressure (or temperature) record before updating the YAML times.

(4) Clock corrections

(7) Mooring knockdown

Measured pressure against height above bottom (HAB) for each instrument with a pressure sensor: median and range of the record. The dashed line is the pressure expected at the design depth. Points below it were pushed deeper by currents (knockdown). Interpolated pressure is excluded.

show / hide
source: oceanarray/plotters/diagnostic.py:draw_knockdown_hab

Pressure anomaly (measured minus design pressure) for each instrument: the box is the middle 50 % of the record (interquartile range); the whiskers reach the furthest values within 1.5 × that range, and the dots are the values beyond. Positive means deeper than design. Box colour marks the median anomaly: green < 100 dbar, yellow 100–200, amber 200–300, red > 300.

show / hide
source: oceanarray/plotters/diagnostic.py:draw_knockdown_anomaly

Horizontal distance each instrument was pushed from its position above the anchor, estimated from how far it was pulled down: treating the mooring as a straight line pivoting at the anchor, a drop from design height H to measured height h gives a displacement of √(H² − h²), so small drops mean large displacements; the estimate is rough for moorings that bend. Left: each point is one sample — how far down and sideways each instrument went, and whether the deep instruments moved with the top ones. Right: where each instrument spent its time — the colour of each cell is the fraction of that instrument's record at that pressure and displacement (each instrument's cells sum to 1).

show / hide
source: oceanarray/plotters/diagnostic.py:draw_knockdown_displacement

(A) Mooring description

The mooring description these pages were made from. To produce the files and pages yourself, save it as dune2_1_2026.mooring.yaml beside the data files and run oceanarray run dune2_1_2026.mooring.yaml --raw-dir <folder with the data files>.

show the mooring description (YAML) 
# Test fixture — trimmed from the real dune2_1_2026 UHH mooring config.
# Kept: the mooring-level header and the two instruments whose stage3 .nc files
# are committed under microcat/ and aquadopp/ (serials 2941 and 9920).
# Dropped: the other ~20 instruments and the full `inline:` hardware section
# (mooring-line schematic), none of which these two fixtures exercise.
# Values are faithful to the source config as of 2026-07-29.
name: dune2_1_2026 #needed, otherwise key error
cleaname: dune2
year: 2026
waterdepth: 745
cruise: OdB
status: deployed
ship: Odon de Buen
recovery_cruise: OdB
recovery_ship: Odon de Buen
deployment_time: '2026-07-11T20:30'
recovery_time:   '2026-07-25T11:44'
latitude: 65 43.913
longitude: -27 48.000
# dune2 is an overflow mooring, so the Overflow grid section is turned on (it is
# off by default; see report_sections in the YAML reference).
report_sections:
  grid: [overflow]
# Extra periods marked on the grid page's spectra (M2, K1 and the inertial period
# are always marked).
spectrum_markers:
  1.8 d: 1.8 d
  4 d: 4 d
  9 min: 9 min
